name: @w6w-apps/sendpulse
description: Manage SendPulse CRM deals and contacts, and send bulk email campaigns.

w6w.longDescription:
SendPulse is a multi-product marketing platform (bulk email, SMS, chatbots, a CRM, and the Automation 360 flow builder) unified behind one account and one OAuth2 client-credentials grant. This app covers two of its modules: the CRM (pipelines, deals and contacts) and Bulk Email (mailing lists, campaigns, senders and account balance).

A deal is created against a pipeline and step, a contact is created bare and then given an email or phone number through its own follow-up call, and a campaign is created against a mailing list with its HTML body base64-encoded, matching exactly what SendPulse's own REST API requires end to end.

Authentication is app-level, minted from a REST API user's ID and secret via SendPulse's client-credentials grant — the same shape suited to scheduled and unattended workflow runs, with no browser sign-in step involved.
